decision.reviewing: How should CB2048 be run now that the parity gate cannot pass for a bootstrap change, and what next candidate attacks the stalling pattern?
options: Run CB2048 ungated as a direct trainer arm with manifest-diff parity at readout
Rework the gate to ignore targets
evidence: Helper traced timeout_bootstrap into collect(): 17 of 128 baseline first-block games are cutoffs, so targets necessarily differ; allowlist revision bc29037 pushed with 91 passing tests
Every harder-trained candidate so far lost the gate on cutoffs rather than losses
decision.reason: Weakening the parity comparison would remove its value; D99 already runs ungated for the same reason. A cutoff diagnosis is the shortest path to a candidate that wins instead of stalling
decision.next_action: Helper analyzes archived bouts and proposes anti-stall variants; package helper rebuilds CB2048 as a direct arm

decision.reviewing: Is the export/ladder path ready for the next gated winner, and should anything be published now?
options: Keep the verified dry run as readiness evidence; publish nothing
Publish Baseline2048 to the roster now
evidence: Dry-run ONNX hashes match the helper report; WASM parity max error 7e-7; sites checkout clean; ledger check reports ranking evidence already published
Baseline2048 lost the strict paired readout versus F1024 and is the reference arm, not a gate winner; its training completion instant is not recorded
decision.reason: Publishing a non-winning reference would not advance the ladder goal; readiness is complete and reusable
